correctness.rationale: The 70 atomic formulas of three named elements encode exactly the quantifier-free type in the language with equality, identity e and *ternary relational* multiplication. Equality of the recursively nested P, Q and T extension sets is exactly the three-move EF back-and-forth criterion. The S3 diagonal-conjugation pair classification has eleven orbits; direct-product quantifier-free masks are intersections of local masks. Independent fresh recomputation enumerated all weak 11-part compositions through power n=5, obtaining numbers of pointed types 3,6,9,10,10 and literal equality of T_4 and T_5 (not mere hash agreement). Congruence of q-equivalence under direct product gives G_(4+k) ≡_3 G_(5+k) for every k and transitivity collapses the infinite tail. Separating type-cardinalities prove minimality for n=1,2,3. No conclusion for functional multiplication language or ranks >3.
